tools.name: un_number_packaging
tools.description:
Find which UN-approved packagings may carry a dangerous liquid under ADR 2025 Table A and its packing instructions.
Use when: the user has a UN number from section 14 of a safety data sheet, or a substance name, and asks what it can travel in and how large. Instead: decode_un_packaging_mark to read

tools.name: decode_un_packaging_mark
tools.description:
Decode a UN packaging mark part by part: packaging code, performance level, density or gross mass, test pressure, year, state and maker, for packagings, IBCs, large packagings, salvage and reconditioned marks.
Use when: the user has read a mark off a drum, jerrican, box or IBC. Instead: un_number_pa

tools.name: ibc_inspection_dates
tools.description:
Work out when an IBC (intermediate bulk container) is due for its leakproofness test and its 2.5-year and 5-year inspections, the last month it may be filled and, for plastic and composite IBCs, the end of its five-year life.
Use when: the user asks whether an IBC is in date or may still be filled.

tools.name: adr_1000_points
tools.description:
Total the ADR 1.1.3.6 points for a road load of dangerous goods and say whether it stays within the small-load exemption, and what still applies if it does.
Use when: the user asks whether a vehicle load needs full ADR. Instead: un_number_packaging for container rules; bund_size for storage.
Inputs:

tools.name: bund_size
tools.description:
Work out the minimum sump capacity for a bund or spill pallet under the containment rule where the containers are stored, and name the rule.
Use when: sizing a spill pallet, bund or drip tray. Instead: ibc_inspection_dates for IBC tests; un_number_packaging for container approval.
Inputs: count only

tools.name: jerry_can_quantity
tools.description:
Work out how much water or fuel to hold, with a margin, and how many jerry cans and 20 ft containers that takes.
Use when: planning an emergency water store, or fuel for a trip, boat, generator or machinery. Instead: un_number_packaging for transport rules.
Water (the default): people times days tim

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search the Fortitude21 catalogue of liquid containment: jerry cans, pails, tins, drums, spill pallets, closures and handling equipment in steel, stainless, aluminium, tinplate and UN-rated HDPE.
Use when: finding products that fit a need. Then: get_product_details for one record, compare_products fo

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description:
Get the complete published record for one Fortitude21 product.
Use when: the user needs the specifications, sizes, part numbers or images of one product, usually after search_products. Instead: get_product_pricing for commercial terms; get_product_documents for certificates; check_product_requiremen

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description:
Compare two to six Fortitude21 products on the attributes they publish.
Use when: the user is choosing between products already found with search_products. Instead: get_product_details for one product in full.
Inputs: each entry in skus may be a slug, a product part number or the part number of one

tools.name: get_product_pricing
tools.description:
Get the published commercial terms for one Fortitude21 product: pricing type, currency, minimum order, quantity bands with any approved indicative unit price, validity, Incoterms and lead time.
Use when: the user asks about price, minimum order or lead time for a known product. Instead: create_quote

tools.name: get_product_categories
tools.description:
List the twelve Fortitude21 product categories with their slugs, taglines and product counts, in two families.
Use when: you need a category slug for search_products, or want to show the user the range. Instead: search_products to list the products themselves.
Inputs: family limits the list to one f

tools.name: get_product_documents
tools.description:
List which documents exist for one Fortitude21 product and how to request them.
Use when: the user asks for a certificate, test report, mill certificate, food-contact declaration, specification sheet or drawing. Instead: check_product_requirements for the scope of a UN status and what a quotation ne

tools.name: check_product_requirements
tools.description:
Report what Fortitude21 publishes about one product's certification: the exact scope of any UN status, its cautions, the documents that exist and what a quotation still needs.
Use when: about to quote or ship a specific product. Instead: un_number_packaging, adr_1000_points, bund_size or decode_un_p

tools.name: create_quote_request
tools.description:
Send a quotation request for one or more Fortitude21 products to a person who prices it, and get a reference back.
Use when: the buyer wants a quotation and has agreed to share their contact details. Instead: get_product_pricing for indicative terms without contacting anyone.
Inputs: consent must be

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ibc_inspection_dates" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: mark, code, made, leak, insp, repair, bottle, regime

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_pricing" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Get the published commercial terms for one Fortitude21 product: pricing type, currency, minimum order, quantity bands with any approved indicative unit price, v…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Private data: search_products, get_product_details, get_product_documents, check_product_requirements, create_quote_request · Public sink: un_number_packaging, ibc_inspection_dates, compare_products, create_quote_request · Destructive: search_products, get_product_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Private data: search_products, get_product_details, get_product_documents, check_product_requirements, create_quote_request · Public sink: un_number_packaging, ibc_inspection_dates, compare_products, create_quote_request · Destructive: search_products, get_product_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
